scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && cp package.json node_modules/homebridge-remote-ssh/
scripts.debug:hb: npm run build && mkdir -p ./.homebridge-debug && node --inspect=9229 node_modules/.bin/homebridge -I -D -U ./.homebridge-debug -C ./.homebridge-debug/config.json 2>&1 | tee -a ./.homebridge-debug/homebridge.log
